products.name: Adobe Experience Manager Forms as a Cloud Service (AEM Forms)

what.text: Enterprise forms product in Experience Manager: teams build and publish digital (adaptive) forms, send the submitted data to back-end systems, add e-signatures and generate documents from the data.
what.quote: Adobe Experience Manager Forms as a Cloud Service offers a cloud-native, Platform as a Service (PaaS) solution for businesses to create, manage, publish, and update complex digital forms while integrating submitted data with back-end processes

products.status_note: Three documented forms: AEM Forms as a Cloud Service (labelled Current), AEM 6.5 Forms (and 6.5 LTS), and Edge Delivery Services for AEM Forms. Adobe recommends Core Components over Foundation Components for new forms. Two integration routes carry lifecycle labels: the Experience Cloud Setup Automation route to Adobe Analytics is marked deprecated, and the AEM 6.5 page on A/B tests with Target carries a Discontinued badge.

status_source.quote: AEM 6.5 Forms Documentation AEM Forms as a Cloud Service (Current)

connections.how: An adaptive form is created in or embedded on an AEM Sites page or Experience Fragment with the Adaptive Form Container and Adaptive Forms Embed components.
connections.quote: With AEM Forms, you can seamlessly add a form to your AEM Sites page. This allows your visitors to conveniently fill and submit forms without ever leaving the page they are on.

connections.how: Edge Delivery Services for AEM Forms: forms are authored in documents (Excel, Google Sheets) or the Universal Editor and delivered through the Adaptive Forms Block.
connections.quote: Edge Delivery Services for AEM Forms is a composable set of services that enables a rapid development environment where authors can update, publish, and launch new forms rapidly.

connections.how: An out of the box connector: forms are built on Experience Platform XDM schemas and submissions are streamed to Real-Time CDP to update profiles. Cloud Service only.
connections.quote: This integration allows you to create forms using XDM schemas available in Adobe Experience Platform and submit data back to Real-Time CDP for personalization and profile hydration purposes.

connections.how: A Marketo Engage data source and a Submit to Marketo Engage submit action send captured form data to Marketo.
connections.quote: Integrating AEM Forms with Adobe Marketo Engage enables users to leverage the capabilities of Marketo Engage to create business logic from captured data and automate workflows, including smart campaigns and email automation.

connections.how: An out of the box connector submits adaptive form data to a Workfront Fusion scenario (webhook); a Workfront and Workfront Fusion license is required.
connections.quote: AEM Forms as a Cloud Service provides an OOTB connector to connect and submit an Adaptive Form to Adobe Workfront Fusion.

connections.how: Indirect on Cloud Service: a form placed on an AEM Sites page can use the Sites page targeting (Adobe Target) to personalize the form by audience. No Forms-to-Target setup page of its own was found for Cloud Service.
connections.quote: Targeting (Integration with Adobe Target): With AEM Sites pages targeting capabilities, you can also personalize the form experience for different audiences

connections.how: Tutorial: a form submission updates a profile, a Journey Optimizer journey starts, and a custom action calls AEM Forms APIs to generate a personalized document that is emailed.
connections.quote: This use case demonstrates how AEM Forms and Adobe Journey Optimizer can work together to automate the generation and delivery of personalized communications based on customer interests captured through a form submission.

connections.how: Forms Agentic Capability: a user asks in Coworker Chat and the capability creates or updates adaptive forms in the AEM environment.
connections.quote: The Forms Agentic Capability of Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) as a Cloud Service is an AI-powered capability that collaborates with Coworker Chat to create forms for data collection through natural, conversational prompts.

connections.how: AEM Forms is configured with an Acrobat Sign cloud service so adaptive forms and AEM Workflows can collect e-signatures; Acrobat Sign Solutions for Government is supported too.
connections.quote: Adobe Acrobat Sign enables e-signature workflows for Adaptive Forms and AEM Workflows. E-signatures improve workflows to process documents for legal, sales, payroll, human resource management, and many more areas.

connections.how: Form events (renditions, submissions, validation errors, drop-off) are sent to Adobe Analytics for form performance reporting.
connections.quote: The service integrates with Adobe Analytics that lets you capture and track performance metrics for your published forms.

connections.how: AEM Forms on JEE only (AEM 6.5): security policies are stored on the Forms document security server, and Acrobat Pro or Standard applies them to PDFs. The AEM Forms as a Cloud Service pages do not mention document security.
connections.quote: Policy protection can be applied to a PDF document by using Adobe Acrobat® Pro and Acrobat Standard.

products.name: Adobe Experience Manager Guides (AEM Guides)

what.text: A component content management system inside Experience Manager for structured (DITA) technical and product documentation: authoring, review, translation and publishing to many output formats.
what.quote: Adobe Experience Manager Guides is a powerful, enterprise-grade component content management solution (CCMS). It comes in two flavors - on-prem and cloud service. It enables native DITA support in Adobe Experience Manager, empowering AEM to handle DITA-based content creation and delivery.

products.status_note: Current, with releases for Cloud Service and on-premise (the roadmap page lists 2026.11.0 for Cloud Service). Earlier name: XML Documentation for Adobe Experience Manager; Adobe says some references in the docs still use it.

status_source.quote: Adobe Experience Manager Guides was formerly branded as XML Documentation for Adobe Experience Manager

connections.how: An output preset publishes DITA maps and topics as AEM Sites pages (site templates and component mapping are configured for it).
connections.quote: users can leverage its best-in-class, single-click publishing capability to generate DITA-based output for the most popular formats - Adobe Experience Manager Sites, PDF, HTML5, EPUB, and custom output through DITA-OT

connections.how: A publish profile backed by GitHub (or GitLab through Cloud Manager) publishes DITA content to an Edge Delivery Services site; output is customized with blocks.
connections.quote: Adobe Experience Manager Guides allows you to publish your DITA content directly to Edge Delivery Services (EDS) through a dedicated GitHub-based publish profile.

connections.how: Authoring, review, publishing and translation tasks are created and tracked as Workfront tasks from inside Guides; an administrator connects Workfront and adds a custom form in Workfront first.
connections.quote: With this integration, you can create and manage Adobe Workfront tasks directly from Experience Manager Guides.

connections.how: Guides content (DITA topics and maps) is uploaded to and managed in the AEM Assets repository; Guides adds its own post-processing to the asset workflow and DITA search to the Assets UI. This is where the content lives, more than an integration to set up.
connections.quote: While uploading your files and folders to the Adobe Experience Manager Assets server, you can also disable the postprocessing and the generation of UUIDs.

connections.how: The AI Assistant in Agentic mode (create and import DITA from prompts, smart tagging) is powered by Coworker; the organization must be onboarded to Coworker and hold credits.
connections.quote: Your organization must be onboarded to CX Enterprise Coworker before you configure AI Assistant in Agentic mode.

connections.how: A publish profile uploads SCORM course output from Guides straight to Adobe Learning Manager.
connections.quote: Experience Manager Guides now supports direct publishing of SCORM content to Adobe Learning Manager (ALM). After configuring an ALM publish profile, authors can generate SCORM output and upload it directly to Adobe Learning Manager without downloading and manually importing the package.

products.name: Adobe Experience Manager Screens (AEM Screens; AEM Screens as a Cloud Service)

what.quote: AEM Screens as a Cloud Service is a digital signage solution that allows marketers to create and manage dynamic digital experiences at scale.

connections.quote: Integration of Experience Manager Screens with Sites lets you reuse existing content and effectively deliver a coherent and consistent customer solution.

connections.how: Player events are sent to Adobe Analytics for proof of play reporting by device and by asset. On Screens Cloud it is enabled through the Adobe account team.
connections.quote: AEM Screens provides an out of the box integration with Adobe Analytics and provides you with a proof of play.

products.name: Adobe Acrobat Sign

what.text: Adobe e-signature service: send documents for signature, collect legally valid electronic and digital signatures, and track agreements.
what.quote: Adobe Acrobat Sign is a digital signature service offered by Adobe that allows users to electronically sign and collect signatures on documents.

products.status_note: Current. Earlier names still show in Adobe pages: AEM Forms and Workfront Fusion pages say Adobe Sign, and the Sign help calls EchoSign a legacy name. One lifecycle item inside the product: the Microsoft Power Automate experience embedded in Acrobat Sign is discontinued in January 2027 (Adobe says most existing flows keep running in Power Automate). A separate edition, Acrobat Sign Solutions for Government, exists.

status_source.quote: In January 2027, the embedded Power Automate experience within Acrobat Sign is being discontinued.

connections.how: AEM Forms connects to Acrobat Sign through a cloud service configuration so adaptive forms and AEM Workflows can send documents for e-signature.
connections.quote: AEM Forms supports both Adobe Acrobat Sign and Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for Government.

connections.how: Workfront Fusion has Acrobat Sign modules: agreement events start a scenario, and scenarios create, read or update agreements and upload documents. No built-in Acrobat Sign step in Workfront itself was found.
connections.quote: With the Adobe Acrobat Sign modules, you can start an Adobe Workfront Fusion scenario based on events in your Adobe Acrobat Sign account, create, read, or update agreements and other records, search for records using criteria you set, and upload documents.

connections.how: Tutorials only, and through a CRM: with Acrobat Sign for Salesforce (or Microsoft Dynamics) the agreement object syncs to Marketo as a custom object, and Marketo sends reminders or notifications. Not a direct connector.
connections.quote: Learn how to send an email reminder from Marketo when an agreement remains unsigned after a period of time. This integration uses Acrobat Sign, Acrobat Sign for Salesforce, Marketo, and the Marketo and Salesforce Sync.

connections.how: The Request e-signatures tool in Acrobat sends documents for signature through Acrobat Sign.
connections.quote: Use Request e-signatures to send documents to others for electronic signatures through Adobe Acrobat Sign.

products.name: Adobe Acrobat (Acrobat Studio, Pro and Standard for business) and Adobe Acrobat Services (PDF Services API)

what.text: Adobe PDF product line for business: the Acrobat apps (create, edit, convert, protect and sign PDFs, with AI Assistant and PDF Spaces in Acrobat Studio), plus Acrobat Services, cloud APIs that create, convert, extract, generate and embed PDFs.
what.quote: Acrobat Studio combines Acrobat Pro, PDF tools, Acrobat AI Assistant, PDF Spaces, and new creation capabilities powered by Adobe Express.

products.status_note: Current, under two headings that should not be mixed up. (1) The apps: enterprise plans are documented as Acrobat Studio, Acrobat Premium, Acrobat Pro, Acrobat Standard and Acrobat Reader Premium, managed in the Admin Console. (2) Acrobat Services, the developer APIs (PDF Services, PDF Embed, Document Generation, PDF Extract, Accessibility Auto-Tag, Electronic Seal), documented at developer.adobe.com/document-services; Experience Manager pages say Document Services APIs or Document Cloud PDF Viewer and do not use the name Acrobat. The connections to Workfront, AEM Sites, AEM Assets and Adobe Analytics are to Acrobat Services; the Acrobat apps themselves connect only to Acrobat Sign and to the AEM Forms on JEE document security server.

status_source.quote: Admins can customize the Product Profiles for Acrobat Premium for enterprise, Acrobat Studio for enterprise, and Acrobat Reader Premium for enterprise.

connections.how: Workfront Fusion has Adobe PDF Services modules (extract, generate, convert, combine, compress, protect, OCR, auto-tag) that call the PDF Services API from a scenario.
connections.quote: With the Adobe Workfront Fusion Adobe PDF Services, you can extract data from a PDF file, or generate a new PDF file from data you supply.

connections.how: The PDF Viewer Core Component embeds a PDF stored in AEM on a Sites page; the page says it uses Adobe Document Services APIs, which an administrator configures.
connections.quote: The PDF Viewer Component leverages Adobe’s Document Services APIs and requires your administrator to configure a context aware configuration in order to use these services.

connections.how: AEM Assets previews PDFs (and other documents converted to PDF) in the Document Cloud PDF Viewer, with annotations, search, bookmarks and thumbnails.
connections.quote: Experience Manager Assets integrates with the Document Cloud PDF Viewer seamlessly, which lets you preview multiple pages of a PDF document.

connections.how: The PDF Embed API sends viewer events (page views, downloads, searches, prints) to an Adobe Analytics report suite; processing rules map them to variables.
connections.quote: To automatically receive PDF analytics events, pass the Analytics report suite ID when creating the AdobeDC.View instance.

connections.how: The Request e-signatures tool in Acrobat sends documents for signature through Acrobat Sign.
connections.quote: Use Request e-signatures to send documents to others for electronic signatures through Adobe Acrobat Sign.

connections.how: AEM Forms on JEE only (AEM 6.5): organizational (server-based) security policies that Acrobat applies to PDFs are stored on and enforced by an AEM Forms Server with Document Security, which an administrator configures.
connections.quote: Created by administrators and stored on Adobe Experience Manager Forms Server (Document Security)

products.name: Adobe Learning Manager

what.text: Adobe learning management system (LMS) for training employees, customers and partners: courses, learning paths, certifications, skills, reporting.
what.quote: Find guides, tutorials, and release information for Adobe Learning Manager, the AI-powered learning management solution for creating, delivering, managing, and tracking personalized learning experiences.

products.status_note: Current. Earlier name: Adobe Captivate Prime (the release notes date the rebrand to July 2022, and one mobile app fix still uses the old name). The documentation has moved from helpx.adobe.com to Experience League; the old helpx links redirect. The Adobe Commerce and Training Data Access connectors are available only when Learning Manager is sold as an add-on to Adobe Experience Manager.

status_source.quote: Read on to know what is the latest offering in Adobe Learning Manager (previously Adobe Captivate Prime).

connections.how: A reference site package (page templates, components, embeddable widgets) is installed on AEM Sites to build a custom learning site on Learning Manager APIs; the Training Data Access connector feeds course data to it. Headless: the client owns the code after install.
connections.quote: Adobe Learning Manager (ALM) integrates with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) sites. This enables you to create your own website and responsive mobile interfaces for Adobe Learning Manager with minimum coding effort.

connections.how: The Adobe Commerce connector sends training data to Commerce as products so learners can buy courses, learning paths and certifications, and reads purchases back to grant access.
connections.quote: Use the Adobe Commerce connector to connect Adobe Learning Manager with Adobe Commerce to enable paid training and eCommerce capabilities within your learning platform.

connections.how: The Marketo Engage connector adds or updates leads from Learning Manager users and exports enrollments, completions and skills to Marketo as custom objects for campaigns.
connections.quote: This integration helps marketers track and act on learner behavior data from Adobe Learning Manager by syncing it with the Marketo database.

connections.how: Documented on the Guides side: a publish profile uploads SCORM course output from Guides straight to Learning Manager.
connections.quote: Experience Manager Guides now supports direct publishing of SCORM content to Adobe Learning Manager (ALM). After configuring an ALM publish profile, authors can generate SCORM output and upload it directly to Adobe Learning Manager without downloading and manually importing the package.

notes: The rebrand date comes from a release note whose old product name has since been overwritten by the new one: "Adobe Learning Manager as a product will be rebranded to Adobe Learning Manager in July 2022". https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/learning-manager/using/introduction/release-notes

Licensing condition on two connectors: "This feature is available only if Adobe Learning Manager is sold as an add-on to Adobe Experience Manager." https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/learning-manager/using/integration/connectors/adobe-commerce-connector

The AEM Sites reference site needs both products: its prerequisites list "Licenses for AEM Sites and Adobe Commerce." https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/learning-manager/using/integration/aem-sites/adobe-learning-manager-integration-aem

The Training Data Access connector is not self-service: "This connector is not self-serve for building a headless or AEM-based non-logged-in experience. Please contact Adobe to plan the right approach for your use case." https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/learning-manager/using/integration/connectors/training-data-access-connector

Adobe groups the two catalog connectors under sales and marketing: the connector overview lists "Adobe Commerce, Marketo Engage" as its eCommerce and Marketing examples. https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/learning-manager/using/integration/connectors/connectors

One more Adobe product connects, outside the catalog: "Adobe Learning Manager integrates with Adobe Connect to help you deliver and manage virtual classroom training." https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/learning-manager/using/integration/connectors/adobe-connect-connector
